The project's ads settings: the landing pages that mark website ads as web-to-app, which send people
on to your app.

Usage:
  voidhash ads settings <command> [flags]

Commands:
  view        Show the landing pages that mark website ads as web-to-app.
  web-to-app  Set which landing pages mark website ads as web-to-app.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash ads settings <command> --help' for more about a command.
